brownfield.boundary: Recorded maintenance observations in one familiar private repository; not an independent benchmark or general portability proof.

comparisons.focus: Structured specifications, planning, implementation and convergence; extensible processes for coding agents.
comparisons.name: GitHub Spec Kit
comparisons.relationship: Overlaps in structured context and process guidance. Compare the concrete workflow and extension set you need; no blanket claim of absent governance.

comparisons.focus: Installs and runs configured multi-language Git hooks.
comparisons.name: pre-commit
comparisons.relationship: Useful alongside Kit gates. Hook execution and the Kit's repository-state, handoff and release contracts address different layers.

comparisons.focus: Agent tool execution with documented run modes, approvals and sandboxing controls.
comparisons.name: Cursor
comparisons.relationship: Overlaps in execution safety. A coding executor can use Kit commands; no measured productivity, safety or cost ranking is claimed.

comparisons.focus: Coding assistance and agent workflows, including a cloud agent that can create branches, write code and open pull requests.
comparisons.name: GitHub Copilot
comparisons.relationship: Overlaps in development and PR workflows. Kit contracts can be an additional repository layer; compatibility with every product mode is not claimed.

greenfield.boundary: Historical released-package first-cycle work/PR/CI/merge/handoff retest in a private external repository; not a retest of every later release.

notes: Zenodo DOI verification pending for v1.1.3.

Make external retests executable: every catalog retest gets an execution class derived from the installed command manifest (local, owner_remote, kit_release), retest commands must name declared routes and options, and a local retest may carry a machine contract (a fixture the Kit builds, agentic-kit/git steps and exact expectations). agentic-kit greenfield retest --id <id> | --all runs the contracts with the installed Kit in a temporary workspace and reports PASS or FAIL per finding; a retest without a contract or one that needs GitHub or a release is reported as not verified, so the run is INCOMPLETE (exit 3), never PASS. Contracts exist for eight findings so far, and every retest must now name an existing route (KIT-GF-070, partial).
Declare the push of transfer remote-next and transfer remote-work-start in the command manifest; both declared only fetch although they publish to the transfer or work branch (KIT-GF-077).
